label: Wikipedia: Jensen Huang
quote: Jen-Hsun "Jensen" Huang (born February 17, 1963) is a Taiwanese and American electrical engineer and businessman. He co-founded the technology company Nvidia, one of the world's most valuable corporations, and served as its president and CEO from its founding in 1993 until his resignation in November 2026.
